Bill.BriefDescription: Reducing nuisance noise from vehicle sound systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reducing nuisance noise from vehicle soundsystems; adding new sections to chapter 70.107 RCW; creating a newsection; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature tominimize the exposure of citizens to the harmful effects of excessivenoise and to control the level of noise in a manner that promotescommerce; the use, value, and enjoyment of property; sleep and repose;and the quality of the environment.

A person shall not cause or allow to beemitted on a public road, park, or other such real property orstructure, project, development, or improvement attached to realproperty sound from a motor vehicle audio sound system, such as aradio, tape player, or compact disc player, at a volume so as to beaudible greater than fifty feet from the source without the priorwritten approval of the appropriate agency having jurisdiction over theroad, park, or other such real property. p. 1 HB 2412 A person who is guilty of violating this section is subject on thefirst offense to a fine of not less than three hundred dollars. Oneach subsequent violation, the person is subject to twice the amount offine as on the last infraction.

Onethird of the proceeds from any fineimposed under section 2 of this act shall go to the law enforcementagency issuing the infraction notice, onethird to the prosecutingauthority of the jurisdiction in which the infraction occurred, andonethird to the court of jurisdiction over the matter.

The provisions of sections 2 and 3 of thisact are cumulative and nonexclusive, and shall not affect any otherclaim, cause of action or remedy; nor, unless specifically provided,shall this section be deemed to repeal, amend, or modify any law,ordinance, or regulation relating to noise, but shall be deemedadditional to existing legislation and common law on noise.
Sections 2 through 4 of this act are eachadded to chapter 70.107 RCW.
